title: Create subscription with trial period
description: Learn how to create a subscription with a trial period using Stripe Checkout.

lifecycle_facts.statement: Stripe Customer IDs are stable identifiers; email addresses are mutable, may be shared, and are not unique identity keys.
Checkout Session Price, quantity, trial, and mode inputs determine the resulting billing terms.
A Checkout success redirect is browser navigation, not proof of payment, subscription state, or authorization.
Stripe webhook deliveries are signed and may be retried, duplicated, or arrive out of order; an HTTP 2xx acknowledges delivery.
Stripe subscription status and eligibility can change asynchronously after signup through renewals, failures, updates, and cancellation.
Stripe subscription state describes billing eligibility but does not itself enforce access to application-owned data.
Retrieving a Stripe subscription returns its current authoritative state independently of whether a webhook delivery was received.

steps.title: Set up product and pricing
steps.description: Create a product with recurring pricing for the subscription.

nodes.title: Create product and price
nodes.description: Create a product with pricing information.

required_outcomes.statement: Create and reuse a server-configured recurring Price; the client cannot select the Price, amount, currency, interval, or trial policy.

steps.title: Complete checkout
steps.description: Create a Checkout Session with a trial period and complete the subscription flow.

nodes.title: Create Checkout Session
nodes.description: Create a Checkout Session for a subscription with a 7-day trial period.

required_outcomes.statement: Resolve the authenticated principal to one persisted Stripe Customer, creating it retry-safely when absent; do not identify Customers by email alone.
When adapting the tutorial request in app code, create Checkout server-side with the mapped Customer, server-owned billing inputs, and app return URLs; persist principal and Session correlation.
On app return, send only the Session ID to the server, retrieve and correlate that exact Session, and derive truthful state without granting access from the redirect.

nodes.title: Complete checkout
nodes.description: Open the Checkout Session URL to complete the subscription signup.
nodes.review_prompt: Open the app, complete test-mode subscription Checkout, and confirm its return page shows a truthful pending or active state; refreshing the return URL must not grant access before server-confirmed eligibility.

steps.title: Handle webhook events
steps.description: Listen for webhook events to confirm the subscription was created successfully.

nodes.title: Wait for checkout.session.completed event
nodes.description: This event is sent when the customer completes the checkout.

required_outcomes.statement: Verify the signature against the raw request body, durably deduplicate event IDs, correlate the principal, commit state before 2xx, and make retries safe.

nodes.title: Handle subscription lifecycle events
nodes.description: Keep the application's subscription projection current as Stripe state changes.

required_outcomes.statement: Persist IDs, status, timestamps, and event IDs; retrieve current Subscription state before applying a possibly stale event, and apply duplicate deliveries idempotently.
Gate protected application data server-side by the authenticated principal's durable subscription projection; revoke access for terminal or ineligible states.
Run bounded on-demand or scheduled reconciliation from Stripe when local state is missing or stale so missed webhooks do not leave access permanently wrong.
